name: Monitor Google AI Overviews and Citations with Pangolinfo

parameters.content:
## Monitor Google AI Overviews and citations

This workflow checks a Google search query every 24 hours through Pangolinfo, retrieves the current AI Overview, cited sources, organic results, and an optional screenshot, then normalizes the response into a consistent visibility record. It is designed for SEO, GEO, content, and brand teams tracking how brands, products, and domains appear in generative search results.

### How it works
1. **Every 24 Hours** starts the monitoring run.
2. **Configure Monitoring** keeps the Google search URL and screenshot preference in one place.
3. **Get Google AI Overview** requests structured AI Overview and SERP data from Pangolinfo.
4. **Normalize AI Visibility Record** prepares the result for storage, comparison, alerts, dashboards, or AI analysis.

### Setup
This template uses a community node and is compatible with **self-hosted n8n only**. Install `n8n-nodes-pangolinfo`, create a Pangolinfo API credential, select it on the orange node, and update **Configure Monitoring**.

Learn about the [Pangolinfo AI Overview SERP API](https://www.pangolinfo.com/ai-overview-serp-api/), explore the [AI SERP Skill](https://www.pangolinfo.com/ai-serp-skill/), and read the [API documentation](https://docs.pangolinfo.com/en-api-reference/aiModeSerpApi/aiModeSerpAPI).

## Configure once, then monitor

Edit the Google search URL and screenshot preference in **Configure Monitoring**. Select your Pangolinfo credential on **Get Google AI Overview**, then test the workflow before activating its 24-hour schedule.

Send the normalized record to Sheets, a database, Slack, email, a dashboard, or an AI comparison step to track citation and visibility changes over time.
